data: Newton’s formulation of dynamics assumes the existence of a frame of reference and time that are absolute. This assumption summarizes our sensory perception of the world. Also, physicists believed that a suitable medium is essential for waves to travel. To accommodate the electromagnetic waves in this scheme, a medium called ether was proposed. Its sole purpose was to support the electromagnetic waves. To prove its existence, Michelson and Morley carried out an ingenious experiment to measure any change in the speed of light if the earth dragged the ether along. The experiment did not confirm any change in speed. Attempts to reconcile this result with the then-existing physics framework were unsatisfactory. Einstein, from a theoretical perspective, announced his reformulation of the basic structure of physics in the year 1905. This course is about telling this story in detail.
